test_ImageTextContrastiveLoss_basic: test the ImageTextContrastiveLoss class by computing loss from image-to-text and text-to-image similarity matrices
test_ImageTextContrastiveLoss_distillati: test the ImageTextContrastiveLoss with momentum similarity matrices and alpha distillation weight
test_ImageTextContrastiveLoss_sim_target: test the ImageTextContrastiveLoss with similarity targets, momentum matrices, and distillation alpha
test_CausalLanguageModelingLoss_basic: test the CausalLanguageModelingLoss class by computing per-sample loss from labels and prediction scores
test_CausalLanguageModelingLoss_distilla: test the CausalLanguageModelingLoss with momentum prediction scores and alpha distillation weight
